title: Revolut ID thefts highlight KYC’s dangers: Here’s how to fix it
summary: Zero-knowledge technology could let companies verify who you are without storing your identity documents. So why isn’t it already standard practice?

title: Bernstein expects ‘aggressive’ rulemaking from SEC, CFTC, following CLARITY Act failure
summary: Bernstein said the federal agencies will publish new regulations to compensate for the time lost negotiating the CLARITY Act, after its cloture vote failed on Tuesday.

title: Zcash holders back 25-second blocks, vote to keep ZEC halving schedule
summary: Nearly 99% of ZEC holders voted to reduce block times to 25 seconds, while keeping ZEC issuance and halving schedules unchanged.

title: Circle launches Arc mainnet with USDC as native gas token
summary: Circle’s Arc mainnet is live with USDC for transaction fees, support for more than 20 fiat stablecoins and links to over 20 blockchains.

title: Deutsche Bank awaits regulatory nod to launch institutional crypto custody solutions
summary: Germany’s largest bank is awaiting regulatory approval to launch institutional custody solutions for Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins before expanding into tokenized assets.

title: Ethiopia cuts Bitcoin miners’ power by 77% amid hydropower shortage: Report
summary: Bitcoin miners generated 35% of the state-owned power producer’s revenue last year, but declining reservoir inflows led the utility to prioritize households and manufacturers.

title: Italy investigates government email breach linked to Revolut data leak
summary: Italy is probing the Revolut-linked breach after its cyber agency reported more than 650 cases involving abused or illicit certified email accounts.

title: Bitcoin Coinbase Premium hits monthly low as CLARITY Act vote squeezes US demand
summary: Bitcoin exchange demand on Coinbase declined after the US Senate voted against the CLARITY Act, while traders sent BTC to exchanges at an unrealized loss.

title: ECB seeks online merchants for 2027 digital euro pilot
summary: Euro-area online and mobile merchants can apply until Oct. 27 to test beta digital euro payments in a 12-month pilot.

title: AI has been a ‘net negative’ for crypto: Phemex CEO
summary: Federico Variola says AI has diverted capital from crypto and is empowering attackers, while rising cybersecurity costs could push the industry toward greater centralization.
